detail:
Decisions: Committed the chore(release): v1.21.1 version bump directly to main instead of via PR — follows the v1.20.0 precedent (898d29c) for release commits; the change is mechanical (version fields only) and already validated by the just-merged PR's CI. A PR would have been the alternative but squash-merging would break the tag-target relationship for no added safety.; Folded the stray hook-generated blackboard entry (subagent-stop noise from the CI watch task) into the release commit rather than discarding it — repo convention is to commit .twining/ state alongside changes, and discarding state silently is higher risk than carrying one noise entry.
Findings: The v1.21.0 tag-push Publish run had failed (2026-07-03 06:06Z) and was rescued by a manual workflow_dispatch — the v1.21.1 tag-push publish succeeded first try, so NPM_TOKEN is currently healthy.; Publish workflow annotation: actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, and softprops/action-gh-release@v2 target deprecated Node 20 and are being forced onto Node 24 — bump to @v5/@v6 majors at some point.
summary: Shipped 1.21.1: PR #27 squash-merged (d32617d, all CI green incl. first plugin-token-budget run), version bumped + tagged v1.21.1, npm publish succeeded, plugin 1.10.1 live in marketplace.
